title: Probe direct bin/mix vs nested devenv shell format permissions

goal.value: Probe direct bin/mix vs nested devenv shell format permissions

script.String:
set -ux
pwd
id
PROBE_REL=test/memba/messaging/fabro_format_probe_test.exs
PROBE=web/$PROBE_REL
make_unformatted() { mkdir -p "$(dirname "$PROBE")"; cat > "$PROBE" <<'EOT'
defmodule FabroFormatProbeTest do
  use ExUnit.Case
  test "probe" do
    assert true
  end
end
EOT
}
show_file() { ls -l "$PROBE"; if [ -w "$PROBE" ]; then echo writable; else echo NOT_writable; fi; }
make_unformatted
echo '== initial =='
show_file
echo '== direct bin/mix format current-owned =='
PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH" bin/mix format "$PROBE_REL"; echo direct_current_exit=$?
show_file
make_unformatted
if chown root:root "$PROBE" 2>/tmp/chown.err; then echo chown_root_ok; else echo chown_root_failed; cat /tmp/chown.err; fi
chmod 0644 "$PROBE" || true
echo '== root-owned before direct =='
show_file
echo '== direct bin/mix format root-owned =='
PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH" bin/mix format "$PROBE_REL"; echo direct_root_exit=$?
show_file
make_unformatted
chown root:root "$PROBE" 2>/dev/null || true
chmod 0644 "$PROBE" || true
echo '== root-owned before nested =='
show_file
echo '== nested devenv shell mix format root-owned =='
PATH="$PWD/bin:$PATH" devenv shell -- mix format "$PROBE_REL"; echo nested_root_exit=$?
show_file
rm -f "$PROBE"
exit 0
